newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia noodle maker sees 50 bln rupiah from IPO.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia noodle maker sees 50 bln rupiah from IPO.

text.p: Indonesian noodle maker PT Asia Inti Selera said on Monday that it expects to raise 50 billion rupiah from the listing of 40 million of its shares in April this year.
"We expect to raise 50 billion rupiah from the listing, which we hope could be some time in late April," President Director Kang Jacob Antung told Reuters.
Antung said the firm would use the proceeds to build a noodle plant in east Java with annual production capacity of 10,000 tonnes of noodles.
He said the plant was expected to be operational in late 1997 and that the firms's annual capacity would rise to around 56,000 tonnes once it was onstream.
The float of the 40 million shares comprises some 30 percent of the company's total share capital.
